sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face an Alsager side sitting bottom of the table with just 4 points and on a poor run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that could be significant for the title race. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth in the table, with Bridgnorth having recently lost twice but Eccleshall in decent form. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture on Wednesday, then face each other again on Saturday—a repeat fixture suggesting both teams are in contention. Bilston Town host Foley Meir on Saturday, with Bilston on an impressive run of three straight wins. Barnton welcome Shawbury United, who are in severe trouble with six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town host New Mills on Saturday, with both teams struggling in mid-table. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half clash, while Crewe host Allscott Heath on Saturday. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday, with Widnes in dire straits at the foot with just 2 points, and then face Wednesfield Community on Wednesday. Eccleshall host AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday.
